source.title: EMDR therapy for misophonia: a pilot study of case series
source.source_type: primary uncontrolled pilot case series with pre/post assessment
source.design: single-center uncontrolled prospective pilot case series; 10 baseline participants, 8 treated with EMDR, 7 post-treatment completers

source_integrity_findings: Abstract reports n=8 for the -6.14 AMISOS-R completer result, whereas the Results section and Table 2 report n=7.
Results text states SCL-90 mean scores decreased by 33%; Table 2 values 172.83 to 154.83 imply about 10.4%.
Safety section states no adverse events were reported while also documenting suicidal ideation during treatment and other side effects; event classification is not explained.
Results terminology calls 10 patients included, then says two without target memories were excluded; Figure 1 clarifies 10 baseline evaluations, 8 EMDR treated, 7 post-treatment assessments.
